_about: Hand-kept English for JP-server unit text that GL has no official wording for (read by build_unitsv2_en.py). Keys are the JP text as the builder sees it (full-width folded, spaces between JP removed, を before a number dropped). In a key # is any number; in the English #N is the key's N-th number, a bare # the next one. Wording follows GL's own conventions (Arts gauge, Auto-fills, CRI rate, Break power, Only once ...). Collab names are the official English ones (Gachiakuta: Rudo, Enjin, Zanka, Riyo; Vital Instruments 3R, Umbreaker, Lovely Assistaff, The Ripper; Cleaners). No machine translation.

_lore.怪盗団『アスタリスク』の団員にして自称、世界が恋した色泥棒。視界に収めたものの色: A member of the phantom thief band Asterisk and the self-proclaimed Color Thief the whole world fell for. Her Monochrome Evil Eye steals the color of anything in sight and paints it onto whatever she likes, and she has run rings around GFR guards with it time and again. Silver hair, pale skin, seven-colored eyes. Though the Guilty Fort Noble Alliance has put an 88-million-gran bounty on her head, she slips on her camouflage and strolls through the crowds as freely as ever.
_lore.人は見た目と能力で判断されるもの――そう言い切る彼女が怪盗団『アスタリスク』を選: "People are judged by looks and ability" - so she insists, and her reason for choosing Asterisk is simple: Azurite and the others see her for who she is. On nights without a job, the three of them, Heliold included, share a meal, and she laughs that it feels a bit like family. A place where she can be herself. That is exactly why she wants to widen the circle a little - lately she keeps trying to recruit a certain newspaper reporter she likes.
_lore.海賊団オクタゴンを率いる女キャプテン。屈強な荒くれ者たちを圧倒的なカリスマ性で束: The female captain of the Octagon pirates. She binds a crew of tough brawlers together with overwhelming charisma and roams the open sea as she pleases. As a child she was lost at sea and saved by Tentacles, the giant octopus feared as the Monster of the Divine Sea, which then raised her. Truly a goddess chosen by the sea, acknowledged by its very incarnation. The Regalia on her pirate hat holds Tentacles' condensed power, granting her extraordinary strength in battle.
_lore.実はとあるレガリアの力で500年の時を越えて現代に生きる存在。かつては残虐非道な: In truth, the power of a certain Regalia has carried her 500 years into the present. She was once feared as a ruthless pirate and shares a deep, bitter history with the long-lived Vena. Yet she was born a God and lost someone dear in the wars between the races. Having despaired of the world, she raised the banner of world peace as her own form of justice, so that no one would suffer as she did - but her answer is an extreme one: to erase the races themselves from the world.
_lore.GFRの秩序執行官＜シークレット＞。『鋼鉄』の二つ名に違わぬ冷徹さと、巨大な手錠: A Secret-ranked Enforcer of Order of the GFR. Cold as his title "Steel" suggests, he wields a giant pair of handcuffs with monstrous strength. His uncanny eye leaves no blind spot to exploit - even the phantom thief Azurite was cornered once he saw through the limits of her foresight. He calmly calls GFR justice "the will of the people, an unwritten law beyond human reach", yet to one question - "Why did you join the GFR?" - he only answers with a cold smile.
_lore.鋼鉄の執行官――その過去を知る者は少ないが、かつては反GFR勢力に身を置き、仲間: Few know the Steel Enforcer's past. He was once a gifted young man in an anti-GFR group, trusted by all his comrades. But when an operation failed, he was shot in the leg and left behind, alone, in a blazing fire. People abandon others to save themselves. In the end, everyone is alone - the day he realized that, he replaced his body and heart with steel. So that they would never break. Hard - firm - unyielding.
_lore.ガナルディア王国で開催されたハロウィンイベントにて、ジュノーが修道女のコスチュー: Juno in a nun costume for the Halloween event held in the Kingdom of Ganardia. She stormed Ganardia Castle, transformed by dark power, to defeat the mysterious vampire Dark Dracrea III, who had taken over Vox's body and carried off Leone. Apparently Juno had prepared this habit in advance, and her friend Dantalia, seeing it, could only think in bewilderment: "Isn't this rather indecent?"
_lore.四天王を倒し、記憶の迷宮を突破したジュノーは、遂にダーク・ドラクレア三世と対峙し: After defeating the Four Heavenly Kings and breaking through the Labyrinth of Memories, Juno finally faced Dark Dracrea III. She won the fierce battle with an all-out Arts that used every drop of holy water, then learned the truth: Dracrea III had been a Crimson Maiden just like them - and, as it turned out, a girl lost in her own fantasies. Knowing a girl had been inside Vox, and remembering all the things he would never normally say or do, left Juno with feelings she could not put into words.
_lore.ガナルディア王国で開催されたハロウィンイベントの準備中に、ヴォックスが呪いのマン: A vampire-like form Vox took through the power of a cursed cape while preparing for the Halloween event in the Kingdom of Ganardia. With his body seized by Dark Dracrea III, the will dwelling in the cape, Vox controlled the knights with dark power, turned Ganardia Castle into a demon lord's castle and carried off Leone before Juno's eyes. The purpose behind it all is unclear, but he seems to be waiting for a "hero" to reach him.
_lore.ヴォックスの身体を乗っ取ったダーク・ドラクレア三世。その目的は「ラスボスとなり、: Dark Dracrea III, who took over Vox's body. Her goal: "to become the final boss and fight the hero the way a final boss should." Defeated after a fierce final battle, she was satisfied with the fight, acknowledged Juno as a true hero and vanished. She was a Crimson Maiden like Juno, and while possessing Vox she tampered with his "Crimson Blood receptor". Because of this, Vox would later have his body taken over once again by a certain being.
_lore.『天界』の少年。犯罪者とその子孫たちが住むスラムで暮らしていたが、養父レグトを殺: A boy from the Sphere. He lived in the slums home to criminals and their descendants, until he was framed for the murder of his foster father Regto and thrown down into the Pit (the surface). Enjin then took him in, and he joined the Cleaner team Akuta. His hobby is picking up trash. His Vital Instrument is 3R, the gloves his foster father gave him.
_lore.掃除屋の一員となったルドは、エンジンや仲間たちと共に過ごす事で、次第に人としても: Having joined the Cleaners, Rudo grows, both as a person and as a Giver, through his days with Enjin and his comrades. His power is rooted in his strong feelings for things that are thrown away or broken.
_lore.掃除屋チーム『アクタ』のリーダー。『掃除屋』とは、ゴミから生まれた怪物『斑獣(は: The leader of the Cleaner team Akuta. The Cleaners are an organization that exterminates the Trash Beasts, monsters born from garbage. His Vital Instrument is the umbrella Umbreaker.
_lore.エンジン率いる掃除屋チーム『アクタ』には、ルド、ザンカ、リヨウがメンバーとして所: The Cleaner team Akuta, led by Enjin, counts Rudo, Zanka and Riyo among its members. Each of them looks up to Enjin in their own way.
_lore.掃除屋チーム『アクタ』のメンバーであり、新人のルドの教育係。カムアタリ街の名門ニ: A member of the Cleaner team Akuta and the mentor of newcomer Rudo. A son of the prestigious Nijiku family of Kamuatari, and an elite graduate of a Trash Beast hunter training school. His Vital Instrument, the Lovely Assistaff, is just a stick - one Zanka wields with total freedom.
_lore.エリートであるザンカだが、自分が天才でなく凡人である事に、常にコンプレックスを抱: Elite though he is, Zanka always felt inferior for being ordinary rather than a genius. Meeting Enjin helped him grow, and now, as a "Super Ordinary", he strives for power that surpasses genius...
_lore.掃除屋チーム『アクタ』のメンバー。新人のルドにとっては『面倒見の良いお姉さん』と: A member of the Cleaner team Akuta. To newcomer Rudo she plays the caring big sister, yet she has a side no one can quite grasp. Her Vital Instrument is a pair of scissors, The Ripper. She can't stand cockroaches.
_lore.掃除屋でハサミ使いのリヨウ。――彼女は、かつて殺し屋であった。今はエンジンに人殺: Riyo, the Cleaner who wields scissors. She was once an assassin. Enjin has forbidden her from killing, but to save her comrades she will take up a gun again, just like before.
